items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: he used to bring all his friends from all over the world into the Paradise to see me

ctx.x: taps, he had on his shoes. And it...ohhh...I'd never heard anything like that before in my life, getting into sound. Everybody had their head down and this man was tap dancin' on the sidewalk, up side the walls, over the fire hydrants and whatnot. I say, "Who in the world is this?" They said, "This is Baby Lawrence." I says, "My God!" Can you imagine a couple hundred people congregated in a corner and they ain't nobody sayin' nuthin' and listenin' to Baby Lawrence dance. Ohhhh!

So that was another aspect of sound. Now I start thinkin', you know. And then, another time, there was Billy Holiday. I'll never forget, I was at the Paradise, so Billy Strayhorn says, "Nick, I got a ticket for you and I want you to come to this concert." I says, "Look, ya know I'm workin' here and whatnot and they mad if I turn around." You know, they want to make this money, 'cause we was doin' very well. So I just said, "O.K."
